input.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `half`, `bfloat16`, `float32`. 4-D.
constraints: input must be one of half, bfloat16, float32

depth_radius.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `5`. 0-D. Half-width of the 1-D normalization window.

bias.description: An optional `float`. Defaults to `1`. An offset (usually positive to avoid dividing by 0).

alpha.description: An optional `float`. Defaults to `1`. A scale factor, usually positive.

beta.description: An optional `float`. Defaults to `0.5`. An exponent.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.
